title: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
description: Saja El-Khawas is the fourth person to die after her family got into difficulty in water in West Sussex.

title: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
description: The seven claimants, who include Sir Elton John and Liz Hurley, have to pay the Daily Mail publisher an initial £9.54m in the next seven days after losing a privacy case.

title: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
description: At least 130 people, including 23 children, were also injured when the shopping centre was hit, according to the regional head.
